relations.subject: Vasily Pavlovich Vasilyev
relations.object: Oriental department of the Kazan University
relations.evidence: entered the Oriental department of the Kazan University in 1834

relations.subject: Vasily Pavlovich Vasilyev
relations.evidence: Back in Russia in 1850, he was offered the chair in Chinese philology at the university of Kazan.

relations.subject: Vasily Pavlovich Vasilyev
relations.evidence: He was elected into the Petersburg Academy of Sciences in 1886

relations.subject: Vasily Pavlovich Vasilyev
relations.object: Department of Oriental Studies at the University of St. Petersburg
relations.evidence: was in charge of the Department of Oriental Studies at the University of St. Petersburg between 1878 and 1893.

relations.subject: Nicolai A. Vasiliev
relations.evidence: His grandson Nicolai A. Vasiliev (1880-1940) was a noted logician.
